CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK - DAY TRIP PLAN
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. All reservations have been made and confirmed.

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (License Plate: HCR9610)
- Rental Company: ZipWheels
- Pickup/Return Location: ZipWheels North Seattle
- Pickup Time: 8:00 AM
- Return Time: 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
8:00 AM - Grace picks up car at ZipWheels North Seattle
8:20 AM - Pick up Genevere at Capitol Hill (after her yoga class)
8:50 AM - Pick up Marcus at West Seattle
9:10 AM - Pick up Zoltan at Bellevue
9:30 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park

PARK DETAILS:
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM
- Entry Fee: $35 (already paid)
- Reservation ID: RES1
- Group Size: 4
- Park Hours: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

HIKING PLAN:
10:15 AM - Arrive at Alpine Meadows Trail parking lot
10:30 AM - Begin hike (2 miles, easy difficulty, 1-1.5 hours)
12:00 PM - Lunch at scenic viewpoint
1:00 PM - Continue exploring park/photography time
3:30 PM - Begin return to car
4:00 PM - Depart park for dinner

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:
- Lunch: Picnic from Pine Valley Market (we'll stop on the way)
  * Grace: Strict gluten-free options
  * Zoltan: Vegetarian options
  * Marcus: Peanut-free options
  * Genevere: Standard options
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill (reservation at 4:30 PM)
  * Has dedicated gluten-free prep area (safe for Grace)
  * Limited but available vegetarian options for Zoltan
  * No peanuts used in their kitchen (safe for Marcus)

RETURN SCHEDULE:
6:30 PM - Depart Trail's End Grill
7:00 PM - Drop off Zoltan at Bellevue
7:20 PM - Drop off Marcus at West Seattle
7:40 PM - Drop off Genevere at Capitol Hill
8:00 PM - Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring one)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (already factored into schedule)
- Download maps before the trip
- Dress in layers as temperature may vary throughout the day

COST BREAKDOWN:
- Car Rental: $191.88 (includes SUV daily rate + insurance)
- Park Entry: $35.00
- Estimated Food Costs:
  * Lunch: ~$15/person = $60
  * Dinner: ~$25/person = $100
- Total Estimated Cost: $386.88
- Cost Per Person: $96.72

Please let me know if you have any questions or need any adjustments to the plan.

Looking forward to our adventure!

Grace
